Name: Kawaii Hats Data File - Titles and Descriptions
Author: Atomos
Description:
[size=2]It always bothered me that the in-game hat names and descriptions for the[b] [/b][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/threads/kawaii-hats-updated-to-1-1-3-13-16-more-hats-lotsa-fixes.109482/][b]Kawaii Hats Mod[/b][/url] do not match the [url=http://i.imgur.com/0U6jjdN.jpg]Hat Images[/url]. I had originally tried to contact the author of the Kawaii Hats,[b] [/b][url=http://community.playstarbound.com/members/yuikami.617855/][b]yuikami[/b][/url], but when I realized he hadn't been around for over a year, I decided to take it on myself.

This mod is just a simple data file edit, and can be created yourself instead of downloading this if you wish. I used the original Vanilla descriptions as much as I could, just lightly editing most, but there are a few I did write from scratch. (See Image to preview the file.)

Maybe some of you can help name these hats and come up with some good descriptions? Any suggestions, let me know.

[u]Yuikami's original mod Kawaii hats is required to make any sense at all in using this mod, as it is just an addon for the names and descriptions of the Hats they created.

[/u][/size]
Unfortunately, the information update is not retroactive to hats you already own, please be aware of this.[b]
[color=#f1c232][size=2]HAT NAMES AND DESCRIPTIONS WILL ONLY BE DISPLAYED ON HATS YOU RECEIVE [u]AFTER[/u] THIS MOD IS INSTALLED![/size][/color]
[/b]

[size=1]I have reached out to yuikami here on the Nexus Forums as well as on his Twitter account, originally to request that they add a data file... If they get back to me and want this removed, (even though it contains absolutely no assets of their mod as it is only an addon file), then it will be promptly deleted.[/size]

Downloads.Description: Put in your Stardew Valley\Content\Data folder and replace
